entries.title: The mod is an overlay on --ax-screen-reader, not a replacement
entries.body: The screen reader mode already renders static spinners, a flat labelled transcript, numbered menus and a terminal bell. Replacing the Spinner was dropped from scope as redundant. Before adding any feature, check what the mode already does with the screen reader actually running; the open issues do not always say whether the reporter had the mode on (AskUserQuestion, #88839, is the first case to verify).

entries.title: Screen reader mode cannot be switched on inside a running session
entries.body: The mode is decided once at startup (flag, then CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER, then the axScreenReader setting) and mods load after that decision. There is no /config row, so $.config.set cannot change it. A mod can only write axScreenReader: true to ~/.claude/settings.json for the next session and announce the restart by speech and bell. Verified in the 2.1.295 binary; source: docs/research/rozpoznanie-2026-10-09.md section 5.

entries.title: Install instructions must avoid in-session pickers
entries.body: /plugin install opens a picker that does not work with NVDA. Documentation must give the shell path: claude plugin install <name>@<marketplace> --scope user, then start claude normally. The same applies to any onboarding step the mod designs.

entries.title: Keep mod API behind a thin adapter so logic is testable without Claude Code
entries.body: Detection, mode-state resolution, settings writing and the consent state machine take injected run/fs/env/store/clock interfaces and return actions; src/adapter.ts is the only module that calls $.process, $.fs, $.store, $.audio and $.ui. Vitest then covers the decisions without launching Claude Code, and manual sessions with VoiceOver and NVDA only verify the adapter and the ear. Decided in docs/plans/screen-reader-detection-plan.md.

entries.title: The mod loader only lets $ reach top-level functions
entries.body: A hooks module fails to load (and claude plugin validate reports it) when $ is passed to a function defined inside the register closure or to a function parameter. Keep every helper that takes $ as a top-level function declaration and keep session facts in a module-level record; a higher-order helper such as runCommand($, action) is refused. Found with claude plugin test on 2026-10-09.

entries.title: Plugin names starting with claude- are reserved; command names take no colon
entries.body: claude plugin validate refuses names starting with claude-, anthropic-, anthropics- or cc-plugin-, so the plugin is a11y-companion while the repository stays claude-code-a11y. Command names allow letters, digits, _ and - only, hence /a11y-on, /a11y-off, /a11y-status. Transcript lines from $.ui.log carry the plugin name as prefix, so the name is spoken by the screen reader on every line: keep it short and pronounceable.

entries.title: Two test harnesses: Vitest for hooks/lib, claude plugin test for the mod
entries.body: claude plugin test . runs hooks/*.test.ts with the claude-code/testing kit and does not descend into node_modules; Vitest is configured to run only tests/unit/*.spec.ts so neither harness picks up the other. In a kit test, stubs beneath the mod answer each $ call event with { value }, mock.env/store/clock cover those nouns, and the test must answer session.start and prompt.submit at the bottom of the chain. $.prompt.submit and $.command.run called from a test take the full event input (wait, origin, presentation).

entries.title: claude plugin test can be blocked by a stale mods rollout flag
entries.body: claude plugin test . answered "hooks modules are turned off in this process: the rollout switch was saved off by an earlier session" although the same suite had passed minutes before. The switch is tengu_plugin_hooks_modules in ~/.claude.json; a headless run (claude -p "Reply with the single word ok." --max-turns 1) with network access refreshed it to true and the suite ran again. Treat this message as an environment flake, not a test failure, and refresh before retrying.
